name: hunt-leaks
title_zh: 专挑代码里漏出来的抽象裂缝
tagline_zh: 闭包注入、跳层调用、注解与图不符、重复领域类型、单例字段装复数、状态枚举蔓延——它逐个点名，并给出针对性重构方案。
tagline_en: Closure injection, skipped layers, mismatched diagrams, duplicate domain types, singleton fields for plurals.
desc_en: Hunt for leaking abstractions in a feature or layer of the codebase. Diagnoses architectural smells — closure injection, skipped layers, annotation/diagram mismatches, duplicate domain types, singleton fields for plural concerns, state enum sprawl, mutable-shared-state reads, etc — and proposes targeted refactors. why_zh: 不是泛泛的代码审查，而是专门诊断抽象泄漏的机制性病灶，每个发现都带重构建议，像给架构做CT。
why_en: Not generic review—it hunts specific abstraction-leak patterns and pairs each finding with a concrete refactor, like an.
limit_zh: 只针对代码库中特定功能或层的抽象泄漏，不覆盖性能、安全、测试覆盖等非架构问题；需要用户明确指定审查范围。
limit_en: Only for abstraction leaks in a given feature/layer; ignores performance, security, test gaps. Needs a specified scope or it may not know where to.
title_en: Find leaking abstractions in your codebase
